\n\n

Let the cost price of each item be C.

\n\n

Profit on the first item = 12% of C = 0.12C

\n\n

Loss on the second item = 8% of C = 0.08C

\n\n

Total Profit or Loss = 0.12C - 0.08C

\n\n

Total Profit or Loss = 0.04C

\n\n

Total Cost Price = C + C = 2C

\n\n

Overall Profit or Loss Percentage = 0.04C2C×1000.04C2C×1000.04C2C×1000.04C2C×1000.04C2C×100\n\n

\n\n

⇒ Overall Profit or Loss Percentage = 0.042×1000.042×1000.042×1000.042×1000.042×100\n\n

\n\n

⇒ Overall Profit or Loss Percentage = 0.02 × 100

\n\n

⇒ Overall Profit or Loss Percentage = 2%

\n\n

The overall profit percentage is 2%.

\n\n

30 persons working 10 hours a day can do 5 units of work in 12 days.

\n\n

Formula Used:

\n\n

Work = Number of persons × Number of hours per day × Number of days

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

Work done by 30 persons in 12 days, working 10 hours a day = 5 units

\n\n

⇒ 30 × 10 × 12 = 5 units

\n\n

Total work in man-hours = 30 × 10 × 12 = 3600 man-hours

\n\n

Work done per unit = 3600 man-hours / 5 units

\n\n

⇒ Work done per unit = 720 man-hours per unit

\n\n

To find the number of people required to do 8 units of work in 16 days, working 8 hours a day:

\n\n

Total work required = 8 units × 720 man-hours per unit

\n\n

⇒ Total work required = 5760 man-hours

\n\n

Let the number of people required be P.

\n\n

Work formula: Work = Number of persons × Number of hours per day × Number of days

\n\n

⇒ 5760 = P × 8 × 16

\n\n

⇒ 5760 = 128P

\n\n

⇒ P = 5760 / 128

\n\n

⇒ P = 45

\n\n

The number of people required to do 8 units of work in 16 days, working 8 hours a day, is 45.

    Given:

    \n\n

    12 students can read 4800 pages in 15 days.

    \n\n

    Formula Used:

    \n\n

    Work = Number of Students × Number of Days

    \n\n

    Calculation:

    \n\n

    Let the number of students required be x.

    \n\n

    Work done by 12 students in 15 days = 12 × 15

    \n\n

    Total pages read = 4800

    \n\n

    Pages read per student per day = 4800 / (12 × 15)

    \n\n

    Pages read per student per day = 4800 / 180

    \n\n

    Pages read per student per day = 26.67

    \n\n

    Total pages to be read = 7200

    \n\n

    Number of days = 10

    \n\n

    Pages read per student in 10 days = 26.67 × 10

    \n\n

    Pages read per student in 10 days = 266.7

    \n\n

    Total number of students required = 7200 / 266.7

    \n\n

    Total number of students required ≈ 27

    \n\n

    The correct answer is option 2.

(Approximate to two decimals.)", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "0.0811"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "0.085"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "0.0775"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "0.075"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "एक बेईमान व्यापारी लागत मूल्य पर अनाज बेचने का दावा करता है, लेकिन वह 1 किलोग्राम भार के लिए 925 ग्राम भार का उपयोग करता है। उसका लाभ प्रतिशत ज्ञात कीजिए। (लगभग दो दशमलव तक)", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "0.0811"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "0.085"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "0.0775"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "0.075"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

    Given:

    \n\n

    Weight used by the dealer = 925 g

    \n\n

    Actual weight = 1 kg = 1000 g

    \n\n

    Formula Used:

    \n\n

    Gain percentage = \\(\\frac{\\text{Profit}}{\\text{Cost Price}} \\times 100\\)

    \n\n

    Calculation:

    \n\n

    Let the cost price of 1 kg grain be ₹100 (for simplicity).

    \n\n

    Since the dealer sells 925 g as 1 kg, the selling price of 925 g grain is ₹100.

    \n\n

    Cost price of 925 g grain = \\(\\frac{925}{1000} \\times 100 = ₹92.5\\)

    \n\n

    Profit = Selling Price - Cost Price

    \n\n

    Profit = ₹100 - ₹92.5 = ₹7.5

    \n\n

    Gain percentage = \\(\\frac{7.5}{92.5} \\times 100\\)

    \n\n

    ⇒ Gain percentage = \\(\\frac{7.5 \\times 100}{92.5}\\)

    \n\n

    ⇒ Gain percentage = \\(\\frac{750}{92.5}\\)

    \n\n

    ⇒ Gain percentage ≈ 8.11% = 0.0811 

    \n\n

    The gain percentage is approximately 0.0811.

    Given:

    \n\n

    Sanjay's percentage of votes = 47.5%

    \n\n

    Difference in votes = 270

    \n\n

    Formula Used:

    \n\n

    Let total votes be V.

    \n\n

    Vinod's votes = Sanjay's votes + 270

    \n\n

    Sanjay's votes = \\(\\frac{47.5}{100} × V\\)

    \n\n

    Vinod's votes = \\(\\frac{52.5}{100} × V\\)

    \n\n

    Calculation:

    \n\n

    Since Sanjay lost by 270 votes:

    \n\n

    \\(\\frac{52.5}{100} × V - \\frac{47.5}{100} × V = 270\\)

    \n\n

    Simplifying the equation:

    \n\n

    \\(\\frac{5}{100} × V = 270\\)

    \n\n

    \\(\\frac{V}{20} = 270\\)

    \n\n

    ⇒ V = 270 × 20

    \n\n

    ⇒ V = 5400

    \n\n

    Vinod's votes:

    \n\n

    \\(\\frac{52.5}{100} × 5400\\)

    \n\n

    ⇒ 0.525 × 5400

    \n\n

    ⇒ 2835

    \n\n

    Vinod got 2835 votes.

    \n", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Pie Chart"], "concept": "Pie Chart", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "669e326fa91a560098d777ce", "qs_no": 16, "pos_marks": 2.0, "neg_marks": 0.5, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "If sin θ + cosec θ = √5, then the value of sin3 θ + cosec3 θ is:", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "<span class="math-tex">\\(\\frac{1}{\\sqrt5}\\)</span>"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "&radic;5"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "2&radic;5"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "0"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "यदि sin θ + cosec θ = √5 है, तो sin3 θ + cosec3 θ का मान कितना है?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "<span class="math-tex">\\(\\frac{1}{\\sqrt5}\\)</span>"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "&radic;5"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "2&radic;5"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "0"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

    If sin θ + cosec θ = √5, then find the value of sin3 θ + cosec3 θ.

    \n\n

    Solution:

    \n\n

    Let sin θ = x.

    \n\n

    Then cosec θ = 1 / x.

    \n\n

    Given:

    \n\n

    x + 1 / x = √5

    \n\n

    Square both sides to find x2 + 1 / x2:

    \n\n

    (x + 1 / x)2 = (√5)2

    \n\n

    x2 + 2 × (1 / x) × x + 1 / x2 = 5

    \n\n

    x2 ", "hn": "\n

    यदि sin θ + cosec θ = √5 है, तो sin3 θ + cosec3 θ का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

    \n\n

    समाधान:

    \n\n

    मान लीजिए sin θ = x है।

    \n\n

    इसलिए, cosec θ = 1 / x है।

    \n\n

    दिया गया है:

    \n\n

    x + 1 / x = √5

    \n\n

    दोनों पक्षों का वर्ग करके x2 + 1 / x2 ज्ञात कीजिए:

    \n\n

    (x + 1 / x)2 = (√5)2

    \n\n

    x2 + 2 x (1 / x) x x + 1 / x2 = 5

    \n\n

    x2 + 2 + 1 / x2 = 5

    \n\n

    x2 + 1 / x2 = 5 - 2

    \n\n

    x2 + 1 / x2 = 3

    \n\n

    x3 + 1 / x3 ज्ञात कीजिए:

    \n\n

    (x + 1 / x)3 = x3 + 1 / x3 + 3 x (x + 1 / x)

    \n\n

    x + 1 / x = √5 प्रतिस्थापित कीजिए:

    \n\n

    (√5)3 = x3 + 1 / x3 + 3 x √5

    \n\n

    5√5 = x3 + 1 / x3 + 3√5

    \n\n

    x3 + 1 / x3 = 5√5 - 3√5

    \n\n

    x3 + 1 / x3 = 2√5

    \n\n

    sin3 θ + cosec3 θ का मान 2√5 है।

    \n\n112:Tc91,\n

    Shortcut Trick\n

    Let total monthly salary be 100%.

    \n

    Applying successive reductions for the remaining amounts at each step:

    \n

    Final Saving % = 100% × (60/100) × (50/100) × (70/100) = 21%

    \n

    Given 21% = ₹1,260

    \n

    Total Salary (100%) = ₹1,260 × (100/21) = ₹6,000

    \n

    ∴ The correct answer is ₹6,000.

    \n\n

    Alternate Method

    \n

    Given:

    \n

    Amount spent on food = 40% of salary

    \n

    Amount spent on transport = 50% of the remaining

    \n

    Amount spent on clothes = 30% of the remaining

    \n

    Final monthly savings = ₹1,260

    \n

    Formula Used:

    \n

    Final Value = Initial Value × (1 − p1/100) × (1 − p2/100) × (1 − p3/100)

    \n\n\n\n

    Calculations:

    \n

    ⇒ Let the total monthly salary be x.

    \n

    ⇒ Amount remaining after spending on food = x × (100 − 40)/100 = 0.60x

    \n

    ⇒ Amount remaining after spending on transport = 0.60x × (100 − 50)/100 = 0.30x

    \n

    ⇒ Amount remaining after spending on clothes (Final Savings) = 0.30x × (100 − 30)/100 = 0.21x

    \n

    ⇒ We are given that the final savings is ₹1,260.

    \n

    ⇒ 0.21x = 1260

    \n

    ⇒ 21x / 100 = 1260

    \n

    ⇒ x = (1260 × 100) ÷ 21

    \n

    ⇒ x = 60 × 100 = 6000

    \n

    ∴ The correct answer is ₹6,000.

    \n\n

    Additional Information

    \n

    Successive Percentage Change

    \n

    When a value undergoes multiple percentage changes sequentially, the final value is found by multiplying the initial base value by a combined multiplying factor of (1 − r/100) for each successive reduction.

    \n

    Base Reference

    \n

    In successive reduction questions, the phrase \"of the remaining\" indicates that the new base for the next percentage deduction is simply the remaining balance left after the previous deduction.

    \n113:T844,<", "hn": "

    दिया गया है:

    \n\n

    खाने पर खर्च की गई सैलरी का प्रतिशत = 40%

    \n\n

    शेष सैलरी का परिवहन पर खर्च किया गया प्रतिशत = 50%

    \n\n

    शेष सैलरी का कपड़ों पर खर्च किया गया प्रतिशत = 30%

    \n\n

    खर्च के बाद बचत = ₹1,260

    \n\n

    प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

    \n\n

    कुल सैलरी = बचत / (1 - (खाने पर खर्च किया गया प्रतिशत + शेष पर परिवहन पर खर्च किया गया प्रतिशत + शेष पर कपड़ों पर खर्च किया गया प्रतिशत))

    \n\n

    गणना:

    \n\n

    मान लीजिए कि मासिक सैलरी ₹S है।

    \n\n

    खाने पर खर्च की गई राशि = S का 40% = 0.40S

    \n\n

    खाने के बाद शेष सैलरी = S - 0.40S = 0.60S

    \n\n

    परिवहन पर खर्च की गई राशि = शेष का 50% = 0.50 x 0.60S = 0.30Sఇచ్చినది:

    \n\n

    ఆహారంపై ఖర్చు చేసిన జీతం శాతం = 40%

    \n\n

    మిగిలిన జీతంలో రవాణాపై ఖర్చు చేసిన శాతం = 50%

    \n\n

    మిగిలిన జీతంలో దుస్తులపై ఖర్చు చేసిన శాతం = 30%

    \n\n

    ఖర్చుల తర్వాత పొదుపు = ₹1,260

    \n\n

    ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

    \n\n

    మొత్తం జీతం = పొదుపు / (1 - (ఆహారంపై ఖర్చు చేసిన శాతం + మిగిలిన దానిలో రవాణాపై ఖర్చు చేసిన శాతం + మిగిలిన దానిలో దుస్తులపై ఖర్చు చేసిన శాతం))

    \n\n

    లెక్కింపు:

    \n\n

    నెలవారీ జీతం ₹S అనుకుందాం.

    \n\n

    ఆహారంపై ఖర్చు చేసిన మొత్తం = S లో 40% = 0.40S

    \n\n

    ఆహారం తర్వాత మిగిలిన జీతం = S - 0.40S = 0.60S

    \n\n

    రవాణాపై ఖర్చు చేసిన మొత్తం = మిగిలిన దానిలో 50% = 0.50 x 0.60S = 0.30S

    \n\n

    రవాణా తర్వాత మిగిలిన జీతం = 0.60S - 0.30S = 0.30S

    \n\n

    దుస్తులపై ఖర్చు చేసిన మొత్తం = మిగిలిన దానిలో 30% = 0.30 x 0.30S = 0.09S

    \n\n

    దుస్తుల తర్వాత మిగిలిన జీతం = 0.30S - 0.09S = 0.21S

    \n\n

    పొదుపు = ₹1,260

    \n\n

    కాబట్టి, 0.21S = 1,260

    \n\n

    ⇒ S = 1,260 / 0.21

    \n\n

    ⇒ S = 6,000

    \n\n

    నెలవారీ జీతం ₹6,000.

    \n\n

    6006 के लिए, अंतिम तीन अंक 006 हैं।

    ఇచ్చినవి:

    \n\n

    8 ద్వారా భాగించబడతాయో లేదో తనిఖీ చేయాల్సిన సంఖ్యలు: 6816, 6006, 5006, 6124.

    \n\n

    ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

    \n\n

    ఒక సంఖ్యలోని చివరి మూడు అంకెలు 8తో భాగించబడే సంఖ్యను ఏర్పరచినట్లయితే, ఆ సంఖ్య 8తో భాగించబడుతుంది.

    \n\n

    Given:

    \n\n

    ΔXYZ is an isosceles triangle such that XY = XZ.

    \n\n

    YS ⊥ XZ and ZT ⊥ XY.

    \n\n

    Formula Used:

    \n\n

    In an isosceles triangle, the altitude to the base bisects the base.

    \n\n

    YS = ZT.

    \n\n

    Calculation:

    \n\n

    Since ΔXYZ is isosceles with XY = XZ, and YS and ZT are perpendicular to the respective sides, they act as altitudes.

    \n\n

    In an isosceles triangle, the altitudes from the equal sides to the base are equal.

    \n\n

    Therefore,

    \n\n

    YS = ZT.

    \n\n

    The relation between YS and ZT is YS = ZT.

    दिया गया है:

    \n\n

    त्रिभुज XYZ एक समद्विबाहु त्रिभुज है जहाँ XY = XZ है।

    \n\n

    YS ⊥ XZ और ZT ⊥ XY है।

    \n\n

    प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

    \n\n

    एक समद्विबाहु त्रिभुज में, आधार पर लंब आधार को समद्विभाजित करता है।

    \n\n

    YS = ZT.

    \n\n

    गणना:

    \n\n

    चूँकि त्रिभुज XYZ समद्विबाहु है जहाँ XY = XZ है, और YS और ZT क्रमशः भुजाओं पर लंब हैं, वे ऊँचाई के रूप में कार्य करते हैं।

    \n\n

    एक समद्विबाहु त्रिभुज में, समान भुजाओं से आधार तक की ऊँचाईयाँ समान होती हैं।

    \n\n

    इसलिए,

    \n\n

    YS = ZT.

    \n\n

    YS और ZT के बीच संबंध YS = ZT है।

    \n\n

    YS ⊥ XZ এবং ZT ⊥ XY।

    \n\n

    ব্যবহৃত সূত্র:

    \n\n

    একটি সমদ্বিবাহু ত্রিভুজে, ভূমির উপর লম্ব ভূমিকে সমদ্বিখণ্ডিত করে।

    \n\n

    YS = ZT।

    \n\n

    গণনা:

    \n\n

    যেহেতু ΔXYZ হল XY = XZ সহ একটি সমদ্বিবাহু ত্রিভুজ, এবং YS এবং ZT সংশ্লিষ্ট বাহুগুলির উপর লম্ব, তারা উচ্চতা হিসাবে কাজ করে।

    \n\n

    একটি সমদ্বিবাহু ত্রিভুজে, সমান বাহু থেকে ভূমিতে অঙ্কিত উচ্চতাগুলি সমান হয়।

    \n\n

    অতএব,

    \n\n

    YS = ZT।

    \n\n

    YS এবং ZT এর মধ্যে সম্পর্ক হল YS = ZT।

At what distance from the spot of the crime would the policeman catch up with the thief, and what is the speed (in km/h) at which the policeman ran?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "11.2 km, 16.4"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "10.8 km, 16.2"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "12.96 km, 16.2"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "10.4 km, 16"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "एक चोर एक वस्तु चुराता है और 13.5 किमी/घंटा की चाल से भागता है। एक पुलिसकर्मी 8 मिनट के बाद अपराध स्थल पर पहुंचता है और तुरंत चोर का पीछा करना आरम्भ कर देता है। पुलिसकर्मी द्वारा चोर का पीछा करना शुरू करने के 28 मिनट बाद भी दोनों के बीच 540 मीटर का अंतर है। अपराध स्थल से कितनी दूरी पर पुलिसकर्मी चोर को पकड़ लेगा और पुलिसकर्मी किस चाल (किमी/घंटा में) से भागा?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "11.2 किमी, 16.4"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "10.8 किमी, 16.2"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "12.96 किमी, 16.2"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "10.4 किमी, 16"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "pa": {"value": "ਇੱਕ ਚੋਰ ਇੱਕ ਚੀਜ਼ ਚੋਰੀ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ 13.5 ਕਿਲੋਮੀਟਰ ਪ੍ਰਤੀ ਘੰਟਾ ਦੀ ਰਫ਼ਤਾਰ ਨਾਲ ਭੱਜ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ। ਇੱਕ ਪੁਲਿਸ ਵਾਲਾ 8 ਮਿੰਟ ਬਾਅਦ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਵਾਲੀ ਥਾਂ 'ਤੇ ਪਹੁੰਚਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਤੁਰੰਤ ਚੋਰ ਦਾ ਪਿੱਛਾ ਕਰਨਾ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਕਰ ਦਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ। ਪੁਲਿਸ ਵਾਲੇ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਚੋਰ ਦਾ ਪਿੱਛਾ ਕਰਨਾ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਕਰਨ ਤੋਂ 28 ਮਿੰਟ ਬਾਅਦ ਵੀ ਦੋਵਾਂ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ 540 ਮੀਟਰ ਦਾ ਫ਼ਰਕ ਹੈ। ਅਪਰਾਧ ਵਾਲੀ ਥਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਕਿੰਨੀ ਦੂਰੀ 'ਤੇ ਪੁਲਿਸ ਵਾਲਾ ਚੋਰ ਨੂੰ ਫੜ ਲਵੇਗਾ, ਅਤੇ ਪੁਲਿਸ ਵਾਲੇ ਦੀ ਦੌੜ (ਕਿਲੋਮੀਟਰ ਪ੍ਰਤੀ ਘੰਟਾ) ਕਿੰਨੀ ਗਤੀ ਨਾਲ ਹੋਵੇਗੀ?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "11.2 ਕਿਲੋਮੀਟਰ, 16.4"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "10.8 ਕਿਲੋਮੀਟਰ, 16.2"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "12.96 ਕਿਲੋਮੀਟਰ, 16.2"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "10.4 ਕਿਲੋਮੀਟਰ, 16"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

    Given:

    \n\n

    Speed of thief = 13.5 km/h

    \n\n

    Formula used:

    \n\n

    Distance = relative speed × time

    \n\n

    Calculation:

    \n\n

    Distance covered by thief in 8 minutes (before the policeman starts):

    \n\n

    13.5 × (8/60) = 1.8 km

    \n\n

    Since there is a gap of 540 m (0.54 km) after 28 minutes, the effective distance to be covered by the policeman is:

    \n\n

    Distance covered by thief during 28 minutes = 13.5 × (28/60) = 6.3 km

    \n\n

    Total distance thief has covered = 1.8 + 6.3 = 8.1 km

    \n\n

    Gap = 8.1 - 0.54 = 7.56 km

    \n\n

    Distance covered by policeman in 28 minutes = 7.56 km

    \n\n

    ⇒ Speed of policeman × (28/60) = 7.56

    \n\n

    ⇒ Speed of policeman = (7.56 × 60)/28 = 16.2 km/h

    \n\n

    Now,

    \n\n

    Distance = relative speed × time

    \n\n

    ⇒ 540 = (16.2 - 13.5) × (5/18) × time

    \n\n

    ⇒ Time = (540 × 18)/(2.7 × 5)

    \n\n

    ⇒ Time = 720 seconds

    \n\n

    Distance covered by thief in this time = (13.5 × 720)/3600 = 2.7 km

    \n\n

    Total distance covered by thief = 8.1 + 2.7 = 10.8 km

    \n\n

    ∴ The policeman will catch the thief 10.8 km from the crime spot.

    ", "hn": "\n

    दिया गया है:

    \n\n

    चोर की चाल = 13.5 किमी/घंटा

    \n\n

    प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

    \n\n

    दूरी = सापेक्ष चाल × समय

    \n\n

    गणना:

    \n\n

    8 मिनट में चोर द्वारा तय की गई दूरी (पुलिसकर्मी के शुरू होने से पहले):

    \n\n

    13.5 × (8/60) = 1.8 किमी

    \n\n

    चूँकि 28 मिनट बाद 540 मीटर (0.54 किमी) का अंतर है, इसलिए पुलिसकर्मी द्वारा तय की जाने वाली प्रभावी दूरी है:

    \n\n

    28 मिनट में चोर द्वारा तय की गई दूरी = 13.5 × (28/60) = 6.3 किमी

    \n\n

    चोर द्वारा तय की गई कुल दूरी = 1.8 + 6.3 = 8.1 किमी

    \n\n

    अंतर = 8.1 - 0.54 = 7.56 किमी

    \n\n

    28 मिनट में पुलिसकर्मी द्वारा तय की गई दूरी = 7.56 किमी

    \n\n

    ⇒ पुलिसकर्मी की चाल × (28/60) = 7.56

    \n\n

    ⇒ पुलिसकर्मी की चाल = (7.56 × 60)/28 = 16.2 किमी/घंटा

    \n\n

    अब,

    \n\n

    दूरी = सापेक्ष चाल × समय

    \n\n

    ⇒ 540 = (16.2 - 13.5) × (5/18) × समय

    \n\n

    ⇒ समय = (540 × 18)/(2.7 × 5)

    \n\n

    ⇒ समय = 720 सेकंड

    \n\n

    इस समय में चोर द्वारा तय की गई दूरी = (13.5 × 720)/3600 = 2.7 किमी

    \n\n

    चोर द्वारा तय की गई कुल दूरी = 8.1 + 2.7 = 10.8 किमी

    \n\n

    ∴ पुलिसकर्मी अपराध स्थल से 10.8 किमी दूर चोर को पकड़ेगा।

    ਵਰਤਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਸੂਤਰ :

    \n\n

    \n\n

    ਗਣਨਾ:

    \n\n

    13.5 x (8/60) = 1.8 ਕਿਲੋਮੀਟਰ

    \n\n

    ਕਿਉਂਕਿ 28 ਮਿੰਟਾਂ ਬਾਅਦ 540 ਮੀਟਰ (0.54 ਕਿਲੋਮੀਟਰ) ਦਾ ਅੰਤਰ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ ਪੁਲਿਸ ਕਰਮਚਾਰੀ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਕਵਰ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਾਣ ਵਾਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵੀ ਦੂਰੀ ਇਹ ਹੈ:

    \n\n

    ਚੋਰ ਦੁਆਰਾ 28 ਮਿੰਟਾਂ ਦੌਰਾਨ ਕਵਰ ਕੀਤੀ ਗਈ ਦੂਰੀ = 13.5 x (28/60) = 6.3 ਕਿਲੋਮੀਟਰ

    \n\n

    ਚੋਰ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਕੁੱਲ ਕਵਰ ਕੀਤੀ ਗਈ ਦੂਰੀ = 1.8 + 6.3 = 8.1 ਕਿਲੋਮੀਟਰ

    \n\n

    ਅੰਤਰ = 8.1 - 0.54 = 7.56 ਕਿਲੋਮੀਟਰ

    \n\n

    ਪੁਲਿਸ ਕਰਮਚਾਰੀ ਦੁਆਰਾ 28 ਮਿੰਟਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਵਰ ਕੀਤੀ ਗਈ ਦੂਰੀ = 7.56 ਕਿਲੋਮੀਟਰ

    \n\n

    ⇒ ਪੁਲਿਸ ਕਰਮਚਾਰੀ ਦੀ ਗਤੀ x (28/60) = 7.56

    \n\n

    ⇒ ਪੁਲਿਸ ਕਰਮਚਾਰੀ ਦੀ ਗਤੀ = (7.56 x 60)/28 = 16.2 ਕਿਲੋਮੀਟਰ/ਘੰਟਾ

    \n\n

    Calculations:

    \n\n

    Total number of female employees = 136,000

    \n\n

    Percentage of female employees in district C = 30%

    \n\n

    Percentage of female employees in district D = 15%

    \n\n

    Female employees in district C = 30% of 136,000 = 0.30 × 136,000 = 40,800

    \n\n

    Female employees in district D = 15% of 136,000 = 0.15 × 136,000 = 20,400

    \n\n

    Total number of female employees in district C and D = 40,800 + 20,400 = 61,200

    \n", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Pie Chart"], "concept": "Pie Chart", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "669e3345ef2d63ee03b1cde8", "qs_no": 22, "pos_marks": 2.0, "neg_marks": 0.5, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "If cos 2θ = 0, where θ is an acute angle, then find the value of sin (75º - θ).", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "&radic;2 + 1"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "(1)/(2)"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "&radic;2 - 1"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "<span class="math-tex">\\((1)/(\\sqrt2)\\)</span>"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "यदि cos 2θ = 0, जहाँ θ एक न्यून कोण है, तो sin (75º - θ) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "&radic;2 + 1"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "(1)/(2)"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "&radic;2 - 1"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "<span class="math-tex">\\((1)/(\\sqrt2)\\)</span>"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "

    Given:

    \n\n

    cos 2θ = 0, where θ is an acute angle.

    \n\n

    Formula Used:

    \n\n

    sin(75º - θ) = sin 75º cos θ - cos 75º sin θ

    \n\n

    Calculation:

    \n\n

    cos 2θ = 0

    \n\n

    ⇒ 2θ = 90º (since θ is acute)

    \n\n

    ⇒ θ = 45º

    \n\n

    sin(75º - θ) = sin(75º - 45º)

    \n\n

    sin(75º - 45º) = sin 30º

    \n\n

    sin 30º = 1/2

    \n\n

    The value of sin(75º - θ) is 1/2.

    \n", "hn": "

    \n\n

    \n\n

    प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

    \n\n

    sin(75º - θ) = sin 75º cos θ - cos 75º sin θ

    \n\n

    गणना:

    \n\n

    cos 2θ = 0

    Simplify the following expression:

    \n\n

    \n\n

    \n\n

    ⇒ (x8 - y8) × (x8 + y8) = x16 - y16

    \n\n

    ⇒ (x16 - y16) × (x16 + y16) = x32 - y32

    \n\n

    ∴ The simplified expression is x32 - y32.

What is the sum of 'a', 'b', 'c' and 'd'?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "398"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "400"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "399"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "397"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "चार अलग-अलग धनात्मक संख्याएँ, 'a', 'b', 'c' और 'd', दिए गए क्रम में, समानुपात में हैं। 'b', 'a' से 35 अधिक है और 'd', 'c' से 60 अधिक है। 'a' और 'c' का गुणनफल 5376 है। 'a', 'b', 'c' और 'd' का योग कितना है?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "398"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "400"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "399"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "397"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

    Given:

    \n\n

    a, b, c, d are distinct positive numbers in proportion.

    \n\n

    b = a + 35

    \n\n

    d = c + 60

    \n\n

    Product of a and c = 5376

    \n\n

    Formula used:

    \n\n

    a / b = c / d

    \n\n

    Calculations:

    \n\n

    a / (a + 35) = c / (c + 60)

    \n\n

    ⇒ a × (c + 60) = c × (a + 35)

    \n\n

    ⇒ a × c + 60a = c × a + 35c

    \n\n

    ⇒ 60a = 35c

    \n\n

    ⇒ a / c = 35 ", "hn": "\n

    दिया गया है:

    \n\n

    a, b, c, d समानुपात में अलग-अलग धनात्मक संख्याएँ हैं।

    \n\n

    b = a + 35

    \n\n

    d = c + 60

    \n\n

    a और c का गुणनफल = 5376

    \n\n

    प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

    \n\n

    a / b = c / d

    \n\n

    गणनाएँ:

    \n\n

    a / (a + 35) = c / (c + 60)

    \n\n

    ⇒ a × (c + 60) = c × (a + 35)

    \n\n

    ⇒ a × c + 60a = c × a + 35c

    \n\n

    ⇒ 60a = 35c

    \n\n

    ⇒ a / c = 35 / 60 = 7 / 12

    \n\n

    ⇒ a = (7 / 12)c

    \n\n

    a और c का गुणनफल = 5376

    \n\n

    ⇒ (7 / 12)c × c = 5376

    \n\n

    ⇒ (7 / 12)c^2 = 5376

    \n\n

    ⇒ c2 = (5376 × 12) / 7

    \n\n

    ⇒ c2 = 9216

    \n\n

    ⇒ c = √9216 = 96

    \n\n

    ⇒ a = (7 / 12) × 96 = 56

    \n\n

    b = a + 35 = 56 + 35 = 91

    \n\n

    d = c + 60 = 96 + 60 = 156

    \n\n

    a, b, c, और d का योग = a + b + c + d

    \n\n

    ⇒ 56 + 91 + 96 + 156 = 399

    \n\n

    ∴ a, b, c, और d का योग 399 है।

    Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

    \n\n

    The question is being answered by Sherry. 

    \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "Sherry answered the question."}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "Sherry is answering the question."}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "The question was answered by Sherry."}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "The question was being answered by Sherry.&nbsp;"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n
    The correct answer is Option 2.
    \n\n
     
    \n\n
    Key Points
    \n\n
      \n\t
    • Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
      • \n\t
    • The given passive voice sentence is: "The question is being answered by Sherry."
      • \n\t
    • In the active voice, the focus is on who is performing the action. Hence it becomes: "Sherry is answering the question."
      • \n\t
    • The tense remains the same when converting from passive to active voice. Here, it is present continuous.
      • \n\t
    • Thus, the correct active voice sentence is: "Sherry is answering the question."
      • \n
    \n\n
    Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.
    \n\n
     
    \n\n
    Correct Sentence: "Sherry is answering the question."
    \n\n
     
    \n\n
    Additional Information
    \n\n
      \n\t
    • Option 1: "Sherry answered the question." – This changes the tense to past simple, which is incorrect.
      • \n\t
    • Option 3: "The question was answered by Sherry." – This is in passive voice and changes the tense to past simple.
      • \n\t
    • Option 4: "The question was being answered by Sherry." – This retains the passive voice and shifts to past continuous tense.
      • \n

      \n\t

      • The imperative verb "Do not jump" changes to "not to jump."

      • The phrase "into the pond today" changes to "into the pond that day" to maintain the same timeframe.
        • \n\t\t
      • "Said to" changes to "told."

      • \n\t
    • Option 4: "They told him not jumped into the pond that day." – Incorrect verb form and awkward construction.
      • \n

      Find the correct ANTONYM of the following word from the passage.

      \n\n

      Proactive

      \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "Careless"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "Prompt"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "Accomplish"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "Provident"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

      The correct answer is: Careless.

      \n\n

      Key Points

      \n\n
        \n\t
      • Explanation: In the context of the passage, "proactive" means taking initiative, acting in anticipation of future problems, needs, or changes.
        • \n\t
      • The opposite of proactive would be "careless," which implies a lack of attention, planning, or effort.
        • \n\t
      • The other options do not fit as antonyms:\n\t
          \n\t\t
        • Prompt: This means acting quickly and does not contrast with proactive.
          • \n\t\t
        • Accomplish: This means to achieve or complete something and is unrelated to being proactive.
          • \n\t\t
        • Provident: This means providing for the future, which actually aligns with being proactive rather than being its opposite.
          • \n\t

        Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

        We met a lot of people _______ our stay in Ahmedabad. 

        \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "during"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "while"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "on"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "in"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "\n
        The correct answer is Option 1.
        \n\n
         
        \n\n
        Key Points
        \n\n
          \n\t
        • The primary issue in the sentence is the selection of the correct preposition.
          • \n\t
        • "During" is used to indicate a period of time in which something happens.
          • \n\t
        • In this context, "during our stay in Ahmedabad" correctly conveys that the meeting of people happened within the period of their stay.
          • \n
        \n\n
        Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.
        \n\n
         
        \n\n
        Correct Sentence: "We met a lot of people during our stay in Ahmedabad."
        \n\n
         
        \n\n
        Additional Information
        \n\n
          \n\t
        • Option 2: "while" – Incorrect because "while" is used to indicate two simultaneous actions. It would be more appropriate for a clause, e.g., "We met a lot of people while we were staying in Ahmedabad."
          • \n\t
        • Option 3: "on" – Incorrect because "on" is typically used with specific days or dates, e.g., "on Monday."
          • \n\t
        • Option 4: "in" – Incorrect because "in" is used for longer periods of time such as months, years, or specific locations, but does not convey the duration as effectively as "during."
          • \n

          • \n\t
        • The correct direct speech form is: “When are you planning to begin practice?”

          • \n

        Select the most appropriate word opposite in meaning (ANTONYM) to the underlined word in the given sentence.

        \n\n

        Human life is transient. 

        \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "thrifty"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "permanent&nbsp;"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "timid"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "tranquil"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n
        The correct answer is Option 2.
        \n\n
         
        \n\n
        Key Points
        \n\n
          \n\t
        • The word "transient" means temporary or not lasting.
          • \n\t
        • An antonym is a word that has the opposite meaning of another word.
          • \n\t
        • The opposite of "transient" is "permanent", which means lasting or intended to last indefinitely.
          • \n\t
        • Thus, "permanent" is the most appropriate word opposite in meaning to "transient".
          • \n
        \n\n
        Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.
        \n\n
         
        \n\n
        Correct Sentence: "Human life is transient."
        \n\n
         
        \n\n
        Additional Information
        \n\n
          \n\t
        • Thrifty – This means using money and other resources carefully and not wastefully. It is not related to the concept of time or permanence.
          • \n\t
        • Timid – This means showing a lack of courage or confidence. It does not relate to the temporary or permanent nature of something.
          • \n\t
        • Tranquil – This means calm and peaceful. It is not related to the duration or permanence of something.
          • \n

        \n\n

        \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "Heavy rains"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "In happy mood"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "In disorder"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "Having dispute"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n
        The correct answer is Option 3.
        \n\n
         
        \n\n
        Key Points
        \n\n
          \n\t
        • The idiom "at sixes and sevens" means to be in a state of confusion or disorder.
          • \n\t
        • It is used to describe a situation where things are not in their usual order or are in a chaotic state.
          • \n\t
        • The origin of this idiom dates back to the 14th century and was initially used in gambling contexts.
          • \n\t
        • Over time, its usage has evolved to describe general disarray.
          • \n
        \n\n
        Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.
        \n\n
         
        \n\n
        Example Sentence: "After the sudden resignation of the manager, the office was at sixes and sevens."
        \n\n
         
        \n\n
        Additional Information
        \n\n
          \n\t
        • Option 1: "Heavy rains" – This is not related to the idiom "at sixes and sevens."
          • \n\t
        • Option 2: "In happy mood" – This option is incorrect as it does not convey the meaning of disorder or confusion.
          • \n\t
        • Option 4: "Having dispute" – Although disputes can cause disorder, this option does not capture the full meaning of the idiom
          • \n

        Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

        \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "Let the veil had been lifted!"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "Please let the veil be lifted now!"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "Let the veil be lifted!"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "Let the veil have been lifted!"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n
        The correct answer is Option 3.
        \n\n
         
        \n\n
        Key Points
        \n\n
          \n\t
        • The imperative sentence "Lift the veil!" is being converted into its passive form.
          • \n\t
        • In passive voice, the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
          • \n\t
        • The correct passive form should be "Let the veil be lifted!"
          • \n
        \n\n
        Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.
        \n\n
         
        \n\n
        Correct Sentence: "Let the veil be lifted!"
        \n\n
         
        \n\n
        Additional Information
        \n\n
          \n\t

          • \n\t
        • Option 2: "Please let the veil be lifted now!" – Incorrect because "please" and "now" change the sentence structure and meaning.
          • \n\t
        • Option 4: "Let the veil have been lifted!" – Incorrect because "have been" is not appropriate for an imperative sentence.
